findings: Closes #8933: replaces the lazily constructed function-local statics in library_loader.cpp (mutex, deque, maps, set) with a constant-initialized SRWLOCK and lazily allocated globals under a LoaderLock, to avoid a null-this crash when GetProcAddress runs on a guest thread with TLS slot 0.
Read the full diff; locking is consistent (every access goes through LoaderLock) and no guest data is parsed. Applies cleanly on main.

Interaction: #8859 adds trace_failed_lookup to the same file using loader_mutex(), which this PR removes, so those two will conflict logically (not flagged textually); whichever lands second must adapt.
